{{Quote|The nobles fight the Imperials as well as the Prince and his misguided People's Liberation Battalion.|[[Grand Duke]] [[Gror Pernon]]|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Rogue Squadron: The Warrior Princess]]''</ref>}}
The '''Eiattu Civil War''' was a conflict between the [[Priamsta]] and the [[People's Liberation Battalion]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eiattu 6]].

The planet was ruled for centuries by the royal house of Eiattu 6. Several years before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the nobility, known as the Priamsta, murdered the royal family and took power on the world. In the following years, the Priamsta found itself embroiled in a civil war against the People's Liberation Battalion.

The PLB was also in conflict with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces on the planet. However, it was led by an Imperial agent who claimed to be [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Harrandatha Estillo (impostor)|Harrandatha Estillo]], a heir to the royal line.

After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Priamsta discovered that another heiress had survived, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Isplourrdacartha Estillo]], also known as [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] Plourr Ilo. She returned to rule her people with the support of the nobility which intended to counteract Prince Harrandatha Estillo. A [[Eiattu Campaign|battle]] soon erupted in which the PLB and Rogue Squadron defeated the Imperial forces on the planet, forcing Moff Tavira to flee Eiattu. During the battle, Princess Isplourrdacartha revealed Prince Harrandatha as an impostor and an Imperial agent, gaining the recognition of the People's Liberation Battalion. The Priamsta was eventually forced to adjust to a new political situation, with a revitalized monarchy determined to rule in cooperation with the people.
